purpose: Bootstrap systemd units follow security best practices including non-root execution, private tmp, and protected system paths.

input.rendered_bootstrap:
# Generate minecraft-vanilla.service
[Unit]
Description=Vanilla No Grief Minecraft Paper Server
After=network.target
Requires=minecraft-restore.service
After=minecraft-restore.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=minecraft
Group=minecraft
WorkingDirectory=/opt/minecraft/vanilla_no_grief
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/minecraft-start.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/opt/minecraft/vanilla_no_grief

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# Generate mcrcon.service
[Unit]
Description=mcrcon RCON Server for Minecraft
After=network.target
Requires=minecraft-restore.service
After=minecraft-restore.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=minecraft
Group=minecraft
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/minecraft-mcrcon
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/default/mcrcon
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/opt/minecraft/vanilla_no_grief

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
